methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $10M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Olympian Motors is a seed-stage transportation company founded by Eren Canarslan and Jasmine Sungu that has raised $9.6M to date. The transportation sector comp universe consists of 6 private peers including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Navier, and EarthGrid, with no public comparables identified. No narrow peer set of same-stage or adjacent-stage transportation companies with sufficient data density exists to support a peer-median valuation method.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable triangulation method, using the $9.6M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding an implied $24M post-money valuation. This represents a standard step-up from capital deployed to date.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $20M to $28M, with a median of $24M. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight peer comparables at seed stage in transportation—a sector characterized by high capital intensity and extended development cycles—and reliance on a single methodology. Stage-progression multiples, while empirically grounded, remain sensitive to company-specific risk profile and market conditions. Validation against subsequent financing rounds or additional same-stage peer data would strengthen confidence in this range.
